question: In a certain code language, 'FEAR' is coded as '31', 'CHAIR' is coded as '40'. How will 'MATE' be coded in that code language?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7e2f79b773d7586660ce7500850ef8e4e1470418572440ebfb10363a8a10657.png] 

'CHAIR' is coded as '40'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ad88a241b5bdb3bd46ccac52b9a5df5cc3af7c589537cbfd177159933b7275a.png]
